title: Payload — review.response_created
$comment: `target` may be a review or another response. A response is a new statement by its own author, so there is no authorship restriction. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
